tw: "Brush your teeth!" says Kron, rushing in to brush a crocodile's sixty teeth.
twc: “要刷牙！”Kron 冲进鳄鱼嘴里，给它刷六十颗牙。

tw: At bedtime, Kron puts ten sleepy limes to bed, one at a time.
twc: 睡觉时间到，Kron 把十个困困的青柠一个一个哄上床。

tw: Don't point at the fat cat, Kron! The cat points back at his hat.
twc: 别指那只胖猫，Kron！猫反手指着他的帽子。

tw: Kron must sweep the floor, but four sheep sleep and snore by the door.
twc: Kron 要扫地，可四只羊在门边睡着还打呼噜。

tw: Kron must wash the dishes, but six fish swish in every dish, wishing for squash.
twc: Kron 要洗碗，可每个盘子里都有鱼在甩尾巴。

tw: A lazy ladybird lays red spots on Kron, and a hungry bird looks a third time.
twc: 懒瓢虫给 Kron 点满红点点，饿鸟忍不住看了第三眼。

tw: "I can't wait!" chants Kron with eight ants at the gate of the cake shop.
twc: “我等不及了！”Kron 和八只蚂蚁在蛋糕店门口齐声喊。

tw: Kron flaps to drive five gray crows away from the hay, but they stay to play.
twc: Kron 扑腾着想赶走草堆上的五只灰乌鸦，乌鸦却留下来玩。

tw: At the Spring Festival, Kron springs out of the lion dance head in his best vest.
twc: 春节里，Kron 穿着最好的马甲，从舞狮的狮头里蹦了出来。

tw: At Chinese New Year, Kron hangs two new lanterns on the ears of a cheerful deer.
twc: 农历新年，Kron 把两盏新红灯笼挂在一只开心小鹿的耳朵上。

tw: Wow! Kron and a cow fold a jiaozi as big as a pillow now.
twc: 哇！Kron 和一头牛包了个枕头那么大的饺子。

tw: Aragon the dragon drags Kron's boat to win the dragon boat race.
twc: 小龙阿拉贡拖着 Kron 的船，赢下了龙舟赛。

tw: Three nice mice jump on Kron's rice dumpling and bump it like a trampoline.
twc: 三只小老鼠跳上 Kron 的粽子，把它当蹦床蹦。

tw: Kron holds his moon cake up by the lake, and the moon soon takes a bite.
twc: Kron 在湖边举起月饼，月亮很快咬了一口。

tw: On Double Ninth Festival, Kron climbs nine pine hills, an old tortoise on his back.
twc: 重阳节，Kron 背着老乌龟爬了九座长满松树的山。

tw: Kron slices his nice rice cake, and a snake takes the slices, twice.
twc: Kron 切好香香的米糕，一条蛇两次把糕片叼走。

tw: On Mother's Day, Kron brings a tray of fish to a mother otter in the bay.
twc: 母亲节，Kron 端一盘鱼送给海湾里的水獭妈妈。
hint: 给妈妈送饭，娃全扑上来。

tw: On Father's Day, Kron gives a gray walrus dad a tie as long as a car.
twc: 父亲节，Kron 送海象爸爸一条像汽车那么长的领带。

tw: In a race of eleven, Kron comes eleventh, behind seven snails and three lemons.
twc: 十一个选手赛跑，Kron 跑了第十一，输给七只蜗牛和三个柠檬。

tw: Long long ago, a strong crow sang Kron a song so long it snowed.
twc: 很久很久以前，一只壮乌鸦给 Kron 唱歌，唱到下了雪。
